comments.value: This would be very nice to have as it would let me hide my UI without me missing out on invite/friend notifications completely, I'd just have to pay more attention to the UI sounds.

that sounds nice and you should be able to turn it off yourself so if you don't want a lot of ringing going in your ears (mostly thinking of people who are quite famous in the vrchat community) i dont want them to get  annoyed by it sense they get a lot of invites, req invites, friends req, and etc... i like to think about who it might effect the most.-Neko<3
I would also like to see feature being implemented. I relax a lot with eyes closed in vrc and missed a couple of invites this way already.

Would be great if it could also hook into the Windows10 message service, that way even when minimised you get a little popup in the corner saying "Shonzo is requesting an invite"  or "Lumi has invited you to [Void Club]"

@{5c70f9386a9e8a2255b770a4|full_name}: would be cool if there was a sort of "log" that can be reviewed so you can see who has poked you in the time that you were gone/asleep/alt-tabbed, even after the original request has expired

@{5ae243864dc68c67fe796424|full_name}: You can somewhat do that through the website I think by clicking the option on push notifications. Would be nice to have an in-game option though or popup yea.  a little icon on the button left of the screen isn't really enough I don't think, especially when closing resting like closing eyes, then you miss that stuff.

@{5a66b7cce81d8d68b372fc83|full_name}: yeah exactly, for me the biggest case would be when i'm working in unity/maya/blender and have vrc minimised, only to switch to it when testing uploaded content. (or to check for the occasional invite)
It would be nice so people can know if you wanna hop in when they have UI off

author.name: Scout - VRChat Head of Quality Assurance

comments.value: it would be nice if we could customize the sound too, upvoted

details: It'd be nice to get notification sounds for when a friend invites you, when a votekick is started, etc. And from other posts i've seen, a notification for when a friend comes online, saying who it is with a sound (adding on to this post) https://vrchat.canny.io/feature-requests/p/notification-to-see-when-a-friend-pops-online-in-game. These sounds could also be disabled in the menu. It is kinda annoying when in desktop mode you request an invite but you are working on other stuff and you keep having to alt tab to see if you get an invite, hearing a little sound to know you were invited would be nice. I am guessing there could be other use cases for this as well :)
title: Notification Sounds
